​Extremely disappointed with the lack of professionalism and poor communication at this shop. After messaging Tony, he told me to bring my vehicle in the next morning at 9:30 AM for a driver’s side armrest repair, saying it would take about an hour and a half.
​I drove nearly an hour to get there, fully prepared to wait for the service. When I arrived on time, he told me he was busy with another project and it would be an hour before he could even start. I agreed to come back in an hour, only for him to change his story again and say he couldn't actually get to it until after 1:00 PM.
​My time was completely disrespected. Communication is key with customers, Tony. I ended up leaving and taking my vehicle to DTX Auto Care in Grand Prairie instead, where they took care of me immediately. I’d suggest looking elsewhere if you value your time and clear communication.
